en.title: Arabic Gum and Bloating: Can It Help or Cause It?
en.desc: Can Arabic Gum cause bloating? Yes, like any new fibre — here's why it happens, how its slow fermentation compares, and the low-and-slow way to avoid it.

en.title: Where Does Arabic Gum Come From? Acacia Tree Sourcing & Sustainability

en.excerpt: Hand-harvested from Acacia tree sap across Africa's Sahel — without felling the tree.
